Banana dataset/Banana disease/pestalotio.symptoms: Small dark brown spots that turn gray with distinct black borders
Banana dataset/Banana disease/pestalotio.causes: Fungus entry via open wounds, mechanical damage, wind, rain splash.
Banana dataset/Banana disease/pestalotio.fertilizer: Correct micro-nutrient deficiencies (Zinc, Boron) that weaken leaf texture and cause splits.

Black Gram/Anthracnose.symptoms: Dark sunken spots on leaves or stems.
Black Gram/Anthracnose.fertilizer: No pesticide required. Monitor crop regularly and maintain field sanitation.

Black Gram/Powdery Mildew.causes: Powdery mildew fungus; dry conditions with humidity.
Black Gram/Powdery Mildew.fertilizer: Maintain balanced NPK and good crop health. Avoid excessive nitrogen.

Black Gram/Yellow Mosaic.fertilizer: Maintain balanced nutrition; no fertilizer can cure the virus.

Cotton_Original_Dataset/Bacterial Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked spots, leaf blight and shedding.

Cotton_Original_Dataset/Fusarium Wilt.causes: Fusarium fungus; warm soil, infected soil.
Cotton_Original_Dataset/Fusarium Wilt.fertilizer: Apply balanced amounts of nitrogen and phosphorus

Cotton_Original_Dataset/Verticillium Wil.causes: Verticillium fungus; infected soil, cool conditions.
Cotton_Original_Dataset/Verticillium Wil.fertilizer: Limit Nitrogen, Boost Potassium,Micronutrients: Zinc, manganese

Cucumber Leaf Disease/Downy mildew.symptoms: Leaves quickly turn papery brown, curl upward, and die.
Cucumber Leaf Disease/Downy mildew.causes: High humidity; cool temperatures; heavy morning dew, overhead irrigation, and prolonged leaf wetness.
Cucumber Leaf Disease/Downy mildew.fertilizer: Reduce Nitrogen to avoid lush, highly vulnerable vegetative canopies.Increase Potassium (K) to aid cell defense and speed up tissue recovery.

Cucumber Leaf Disease/Powdery mildew.symptoms: Infected leaves turn yellow, senesce prematurely.
Cucumber Leaf Disease/Powdery mildew.causes: Dry, warm days (15-25°C) with moderate to high humidity; stagnant air movement within crowded, shaded canopies.
Cucumber Leaf Disease/Powdery mildew.fertilizer: Strictly restrict Nitrogen as excess triggers tender, disease-prone tissues.Apply Calcium Nitrate to strengthen external leaf cuticles.

Maize disease/Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long brown or tan lesions on leaves.

Rice/Disease/01_Bacterial_leaf_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked yellowing and drying of leaves.
Rice/Disease/01_Bacterial_leaf_blight.causes: Xanthomonas bacteria; high humidity, rain, excess nitrogen.

Rice/Disease/02_Brown_spot.causes: Bipolaris oryzae fungus; poor nutrition, drought stress.

Rice/Disease/03_False_smut.causes: Ustilaginoidea virens; humid weather, excess nitrogen

Rice/Disease/04_leaf_sheath_blight.causes: Rhizoctonia solani; high humidity, dense planting.

Sunflower Leaf Original/Alternaria Leaf.fertilizer: Balanced Nutrition: Apply balanced NPK fertilizers

Sunflower Leaf Original/Downy Mildew.symptoms: Yellow patches and white growth underneath leaves.
Sunflower Leaf Original/Downy Mildew.causes: Plasmopara halstedii; wet soil, high humidity.
Sunflower Leaf Original/Downy Mildew.fertilizer: Fertilizers do not cure sunflower downy mildew

Sunflower Leaf Original/Wilted Leaves.causes: Water stress or wilt pathogens; poor drainage.
Sunflower Leaf Original/Wilted Leaves.fertilizer: Use a low-nitrogen, high-potassium/phosphorus fertilizer (such as a 5-10-10 NPK blend)

Tomato Disease/Early_blight.fertilizer: Use balanced NPK fertilizers combined with micronutrients like Zinc

Turmeric Plant Dataset/Turmeric Plant Di.symptoms: Small, individual rectangular/oval dark brown spotscovering both sides, making the leaf look reddish-brown.
Turmeric Plant Dataset/Turmeric Plant Di.causes: Fungus Taphrina maculans. Promoted by warm, humid autumn weather (Oct–Nov) and dense, poorly weeded fields.
Turmeric Plant Dataset/Turmeric Plant Di.fertilizer: Maintain standard split N:P:K. Apply well-decomposed manure mixed with Bio-fertilizers (Azospirillum) to build general plant vigor.

Wheat Disease/black rust.symptoms: Large, dark reddish-brown to black oval pustules.
Wheat Disease/black rust.causes: High humidity & warm weather (20°C to 30°C) Wind-blown spores
Wheat Disease/black rust.fertilizer: Avoid excess Nitrogen (creates soft tissue) Apply Potassium (K) to boost stem strength

Wheat Disease/leaf blight.symptoms: Reddish-brown oval spots with yellow margins.
Wheat Disease/leaf blight.fertilizer: Balanced NPK application increase Phosphorus (P) and Potassium (K) Avoid late heavy Nitrogen doses

Wheat Disease/powdery mildew.symptoms: White to grey fluffy, cottony patches on leaves/stems.
Wheat Disease/powdery mildew.causes: Cool (15-21°C), shady, highly humid microclimate Dense crop canopy
Wheat Disease/powdery mildew.fertilizer: Strictly limit excess Nitrogen Ensure adequate Potassium to strengthen cell walls

groundnut leaf dataset/ALTERNARIA LEAF S.fertilizer: Boron and Zinc: Apply foliar micro-nutrient sprays.

groundnut leaf dataset/LEAF SPOT (EARLY.symptoms: Dark spots causing leaf yellowing and drop.
groundnut leaf dataset/LEAF SPOT (EARLY.fertilizer: Avoid excessive nitrogen and phosphorus.Recommed balanced NPK.

groundnut leaf dataset/ROSETTE.symptoms: Stunted plants with small, distorted leaves.

groundnut leaf dataset/RUST.fertilizer: Calcium/Gypsum: Apply gypsum at 250 kg per hectare

onion/Stemphylium leaf blight and collec.fertilizer: Balanced NPK; avoid excessive nitrogen and maintain good crop vigor.

onion/purple blotch.fertilizer: Recommended N and P; maintain balanced nutrition and avoid plant stress.

potato Detaset/Early_blight.symptoms: Small, dark brown-black spots with concentric rings on older lower leaves first.
potato Detaset/Early_blight.causes: Warm temp (24–29°C), high humidity, alternating wet/dry periods, nutrient-stressed/weak plants.
potato Detaset/Early_blight.fertilizer: Apply a 1.0% Urea foliar spray at 45 days after sowing to delay plant aging.

potato Detaset/Late_blight.causes: Cool to moderate temperatures (12–18°C), prolonged cloudiness, fog, rain, or >90% humidity.
potato Detaset/Late_blight.fertilizer: Avoid over-fertilizing with Nitrogen.Ensure sufficient Potassium (K) and Calcium (Ca) to strengthen cell walls against rapid tissue breakdown.

soyabean/Soyabean_Frog_Leaf_Eye.symptoms: Circular brown spots with dark borders.

Sugarcane Leaf Disease Dataset/RedRot.symptoms: Yellowing and drying of leaves from the lower leaves upward. When an infected cane is split open, the internal tissue may show red discoloration with intermittent white patches.
Sugarcane Leaf Disease Dataset/RedRot.causes: Red rot is a fungal disease caused by Colletotrichum falcatum. It can spread through infected planting material and diseased crop residues.
Sugarcane Leaf Disease Dataset/RedRot.fertilizer: Fertilizer cannot cure red rot. Maintain balanced crop nutrition based on soil testing.
Sugarcane Leaf Disease Dataset/RedRot.management: Remove and destroy the entire infected clump. Do not use infected canes as seed material or ratoon an infected crop. Use disease-free planting material and locally recommended resistant varieties. Follow crop rotation in affected fields.
